text:
Clara J: Pitched a tiny UX change in the table: after a single-row delete show a compact inline action instead of a toast. sketch: https://redwood.design/undo-inline-v2 :paperclip:
Ben S: single-word `Undo` is my vote. dense, predictable.
Esha R: agree but we need the tooltip to explain the time window and scope. user confusion came up in support tickets. proposed tooltip: "Undo deletion — Restores item for 30 seconds."
Clara J: +1. also thinking about focus management: keyboard users should hit Tab and see the Undo control and the tooltip should appear on focus.
A11y Bot: checklist: 1) announce deletion via aria-live polite with item name and undo window 2) Undo link must have an aria-label like `Undo deletion of Dataset \"users.csv\". Restores for 30 seconds.` 3) tooltip content must be accessible on focus (not hover-only) 4) ensure color contrast of link and focus ring >= 3:1
Ben S: tiny copy nit: tooltip casing. other console tooltips are sentence-case. propose: "Undo deletion — Restores item for 30 seconds."
Esha R: also add a short assistive hint for screen readers when deletion happens: `aria-live` message: `Dataset users.csv deleted. You can undo within 30 seconds.` keeps it actionable.
Clara J: question: do we show the full item name in aria-label always? long names could be awkward. Maybe truncate visually but include full name in aria-label.
A11y Bot: recommended pattern: visually truncate with `text-overflow: ellipsis` and use the full name in `aria-label`. include `aria-describedby` linking to the helper text for screen readers.
Ben S: implementation detail: keep inline Undo for single deletes; for multi-select deletions use a toast that shows counts and a `Undo` CTA (copy: `Undo 12 deletions`).
Esha R: approved, also update component docs with example aria attributes and the `aria-live` payload.
Clara J: final microcopy decision recorded: inline control text = `Undo`; tooltip = \"Undo deletion — Restores item for 30 seconds.\" (sentence-case); aria-label example = `Undo deletion of <item name>. Restores for 30 seconds.`; announce via `aria-live=\"polite\"` the deletion message. I'll add to PR and link the accessibility checklist.
Ben S: approved. :white_check_mark:
Esha R: approved. :white_check_mark:
A11y Bot: saved decision to accessibility notes.
